title: Egyptian symbols in a Freemasonic temple in DC

tellings.quote: I've been inside of this like Freemasonic temple in DC

plain: Michels says he has been inside a temple of the Freemasons, an old fraternal society with secret rituals, in Washington DC, and that it is full of ancient Egyptian symbols. He tells this from his own visit, in passing, as a sign that old esoteric ideas sit close to the centre of American power.
